mcq.q: Who created the C language at Bell Labs?
mcq.e: C was created by Dennis Ritchie; Stroustrup made C++ and Gosling made Java.

mcq.q: Which language was created by Bjarne Stroustrup?
mcq.e: C++ is Stroustrup's; C is Ritchie's and Java is Gosling's.

mcq.q: The full form of the language name FORTRAN is:
mcq.e: FORTRAN = Formula Translation.

mcq.q: In C, tokens are:
o: Only the keywords of the language
The smallest individual units of a program as well as the basic elements recognised by the compiler
Only the variables declared in a program
mcq.e: Tokens are both the smallest units of a C program and the basic elements the compiler recognises.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a valid C identifier?
mcq.e: An identifier may start with a letter or underscore but never with a digit.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a keyword in C?
mcq.e: volatile is a C keyword; variable, automatic and integer are not (the real words are auto, int).

mcq.q: In the declaration int a, b, c = 10; (inside a function), what do a and b contain?
mcq.e: Only c is initialised; uninitialised local variables hold indeterminate values, never an automatic 0.

mcq.q: Which statement about the default value of a register variable is correct?
mcq.e: A register variable lives in a CPU register but its default value is garbage, not zero.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a storage class in C?
mcq.e: The storage classes are auto, register, static and extern; there is no 'intern'.

mcq.q: Which storage class variables retain their value between function calls and default to 0?
mcq.e: static variables are initialised to 0 by default and keep their value between calls.

mcq.q: With short = 2 bytes, float = 4 bytes, long = 8 bytes, how many bytes does struct { short a[5]; union { float v; long z; } u; } occupy (no padding considered)?
mcq.e: Struct adds members: 5x2 = 10; the union takes its largest member (8); total 18.

mcq.q: The #include directive is resolved during which stage?
mcq.e: The preprocessor runs before compilation and replaces #include with the file's contents.

mcq.q: What is the value of x after: int a=8,b=5,c=10,d=3,e=2,f=7,g=3; x = a + b*(c-d)/e + f%g;  (integer arithmetic)
mcq.e: b*(c-d) = 35, 35/2 = 17 (integer division), f%g = 1, so 8 + 17 + 1 = 26.

mcq.q: Which operator has the highest precedence in C?
mcq.e: Parentheses are highest; % ranks with * and /, and = is lowest.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT an arithmetic operator?
mcq.e: && is a logical operator.

mcq.q: The ?: operator in C takes how many operands?
mcq.e: ?: is the only ternary operator, so it has exactly three operands.

mcq.q: What is the value of c after: int x=0, a=0; char r = x ? 'a' : a ? 'b' : 'c';  (value of r)
mcq.e: ?: is right-associative; x is 0 so the second ?: is evaluated; a is 0 so 'c' results.

mcq.q: What does the statement x -= y + 1; mean?
mcq.e: A compound assignment applies to the whole right-hand side: x = x - (y + 1).

mcq.q: What value is stored in k after: int v, k; k = (v = 20, v + 2);
mcq.e: The comma operator evaluates left to right and keeps the right value: v + 2 = 22.

mcq.q: What is the result of -7 % 3 in C?
mcq.e: The result of % takes the sign of the dividend, so -7 % 3 = -1.

mcq.q: What is the result of 7 % -3 in C?
mcq.e: The sign follows the dividend (7), so the result is 1.

mcq.q: What is the value of 4 ^ 3 in C?
mcq.e: ^ is bitwise XOR: 100 XOR 011 = 111 = 7.

mcq.q: What does printf("%d", printf("C Programming")); print?
mcq.e: The inner printf prints 'C Programming' and returns 13 (characters printed), which the outer printf then prints.

mcq.q: What does printf("%d%d%d", 62, 062, 0x62); print?
mcq.e: 062 is octal = 50 and 0x62 is hex = 98, so the output is 62 50 98.

mcq.q: Which loop is infinite?
mcq.e: Any non-zero value is true, so while(5) never stops; only 0 is false.
A do-while runs its body first, so 5 is printed once before the condition fails.

mcq.q: Which loop always executes its body at least once?
mcq.e: do-while tests the condition after the body.

mcq.q: In a for loop, what happens if the condition part is omitted?
mcq.e: All three parts of for are optional; with no condition the loop never terminates by itself.

mcq.q: In a dangling-else situation, an else binds to:
o: The first if in the program
The if that is indented the same
mcq.e: An else always pairs with the nearest preceding unmatched if, whatever the indentation.
There is no break, so control falls through from case 5 into default.

mcq.q: A loop 'for (j = 1; j <= n; ) j = j * 2;' makes how many comparisons?
mcq.e: j doubles each time, so the body runs about log n times and the condition is tested log n + 1 times.

mcq.q: A function prototype tells the compiler:
o: The number and types of arguments and the return type
The local variables of the function
mcq.e: A prototype is the interface only: argument count, argument types and return type.

mcq.q: A function is declared with the prototype void func(void); and called as func(10). What happens?
mcq.e: The call must match the prototype; passing an argument to func(void) is a compile-time error.

mcq.q: To modify a caller's variable from a called function in C, you should:
o: Pass the address of the variable
mcq.e: Call by value only copies; passing the address lets the function change the original.
The inner y shadows the outer y only inside the block; x is changed to 11, outer y stays 20.

mcq.q: Which declaration describes a function fun taking (float *, char **) and returning int **?
mcq.e: Each pointer level adds a star: pointer-to-pointer-to-int return, float pointer and char pointer-to-pointer arguments.

mcq.q: Variable-argument (variadic) functions in C use macros such as va_list, va_start and va_arg declared in:
mcq.e: The variadic macros come from <stdarg.h>.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a valid declaration of a 2D array in C?
mcq.e: Only the first dimension may be omitted and each dimension needs its own brackets.

mcq.q: For int arr[2][2] = {{1,2},{3,4}}; which expression does NOT give 4?
mcq.e: *(*arr+1) is arr[0][1], which is 2.

mcq.q: What does printf("Hello, World!" + 7) print?
mcq.e: A char pointer advanced by 7 points to 'W' and prints from there to the null character.

mcq.q: char *S = "MySQL"; S += 2; printf("%s", S); prints:
mcq.e: S now points to the third character, so it prints SQL.

mcq.q: What is the difference between int *arr[5] and int (*arr)[5]?
o: First is an array of 5 int pointers; second is a pointer to an array of 5 ints
First is a pointer to an array; second is an array of pointers
mcq.e: Parentheses change the binding: *arr[5] is an array of pointers, (*arr)[5] is a pointer to an array.

mcq.q: What does scanf("%4s", str) store if the input is HelloWorld?
mcq.e: %4s reads at most 4 characters.

mcq.q: Which function writes formatted output into a character buffer and returns the number of characters written?
mcq.e: sprintf writes into a buffer and returns the character count.

mcq.q: How do you access the member price of a structure variable book, and of a pointer p to the structure?
mcq.e: Dot is for a structure variable; arrow is for a pointer to a structure.

mcq.q: In fopen, which mode allows both reading and appending?
mcq.e: "a+" reads and appends; w+ reads/writes but truncates; r only reads.

mcq.q: Which call rewinds a file to its beginning?
mcq.e: fseek with SEEK_SET and offset 0 goes to the start; ftell only reports the position.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT an OOP concept?
mcq.e: Platform independence comes from a virtual machine, not from OOP itself.

mcq.q: Which of the following was the first object-oriented language?
mcq.e: Simula was the first OOP language.

mcq.q: Wrapping data and the functions that operate on it into a single unit is called:
mcq.e: Encapsulation bundles data and functions together; abstraction only exposes essential features.

mcq.q: Which statement about a constructor is FALSE?
o: It is called when an object is created
The compiler provides a default one if none is defined
It must have a return type
mcq.e: Constructors have no return type, not even void.

mcq.q: What is the default access of members in a C++ class and in a C++ struct respectively?
mcq.e: A class defaults to private; a struct defaults to public.

mcq.q: Private members of a base class, in a derived class, are:
o: Not inherited at all and accessible
mcq.e: Private members are inherited but cannot be accessed directly in the derived class.

mcq.q: A friend function can access which members of a class?
mcq.e: A friend, though a non-member, can access all members of the class.

mcq.q: A pointer pp is created by new[] for an array. How should the memory be released?
mcq.e: Memory from new[] must be released with delete [].

mcq.q: Which operator is the stream insertion operator in C++?
mcq.e: << is the insertion operator used with cout; >> with cin is extraction.

mcq.q: Which C++ keyword/mechanism enables run-time polymorphism?
mcq.e: Virtual functions give dynamic binding (run-time polymorphism); overloading and templates are compile-time.

mcq.q: Which of the following can NOT distinguish overloaded functions?
mcq.e: Return type alone can never distinguish overloads.

mcq.q: A class containing at least one pure virtual function is called:
mcq.e: Such a class is abstract and cannot be instantiated.

mcq.q: Multiple inheritance means:
o: A class derived from many base classes
One base class with many derived classes
mcq.e: Multiple inheritance = one derived class from many bases; the chain is multilevel and one-base-many-children is hierarchical.

mcq.q: What does the scope resolution operator :: allow in an overriding scenario?
o: Call the base-class version of an overridden function
mcq.e: Base::func() calls the base version from the derived class.

mcq.q: In Java, how is multiple inheritance achieved?
mcq.e: Java does not allow multiple class inheritance; it achieves it via interfaces.

mcq.q: Which Java statement about 'final' is TRUE?
o: A final method can be overridden
A final class cannot be subclassed
A final class can be extended once
mcq.e: final classes (e.g. String) cannot be subclassed and final methods cannot be overridden.

mcq.q: Arrange Java access levels from most restrictive to least restrictive:
mcq.e: Order is private < default (package) < protected < public.

mcq.q: In Java, 'try' can be followed by:
o: Only one catch and many finally blocks
Many catch blocks but only one finally block
Only one catch and one finally
mcq.e: A try may have many catches but only one finally.

mcq.q: What is printed by System.out.println("exam:" + 9 + 9 + 9);
mcq.e: String concatenation proceeds left to right, so each 9 is appended as text.

mcq.q: Which of the following is NOT a feature of ADO.NET?
mcq.e: Reachability is not an ADO.NET feature.

mcq.q: In the .NET pipeline, the execution engine that manages programs (with JIT inside) is:
mcq.e: CLR is the virtual-machine-like execution engine; IL/MSIL is the CPU-independent instruction set.

tf.s: In C, an uninitialised local variable automatically holds 0.
The comma operator returns the value of its right operand.
&& is an arithmetic operator in C.
In a switch statement, control falls through to the next case until a break or the end is reached.
tf.n: That is why case 5 without break prints FiveDefault.

tf.s: A do-while loop's condition is tested before the body is executed.
tf.n: The body runs first, then the condition is tested.

tf.s: In C, arr[i] is equivalent to *(arr + i).
tf.n: Both access element i of the array.

tf.s: The size of the whole array int arr[5] given by sizeof is the size of a pointer.
tf.n: sizeof an array gives the whole array size (20 bytes with 4-byte int).

tf.s: In C++, a struct has private members by default.
tf.n: A struct is public by default; a class is private by default.

tf.s: A friend function can access private and protected members of a class.
tf.n: A friend is a non-member with access to all members.

tf.s: Method overloading is resolved at run time in Java.
tf.n: Overloading is compile-time (static binding); overriding is run-time (dynamic binding).

tf.s: An abstract class cannot be instantiated.
tf.n: A class with a pure virtual/abstract method must be derived and defined first.

tf.s: In Java, a final method can be overridden in a subclass.
The fseek function reports the current file position.
tf.n: ftell reports the position; fseek sets it.

tf.s: A destructor is mandatory when objects are created dynamically and own resources.
tf.n: Destructors deallocate the resources held by such objects.
